credit_headline.narrative: Non-food credit grew 18.77% year-on-year in August 2026, easing 0.29 points from 19.06% after three straight months of acceleration that took it from 15.8% in April to 19.1% in July — still above the 16.6% mark that tops this window's range. That slight easing in pace comes alongside unchanged breadth: all four main sectors — agriculture, industry, services, retail — again posted positive YoY growth, a reading breadth has held for most of the last 25 periods. Together, the two signals show a credit cycle that stays broad-based across sectors even as its fastest leg of growth eases a touch.
